row.notes: Writes a 0x30-byte item record (key u32 at +0x10, 16 bytes at +0x18, u32 +0x28, u32 +0x2c). Null source gives the null key 0xffff0000. Otherwise searches the override table self+0x10 (count at self+0x1810, stride 0x30) for the same type byte (source+0x18) and id u16 (source+0x1a) and copies that entry; if none matches it copies key source+0x18, 16 bytes source+0x34 and u32 source+0x50. Context from caller: override table is the livery preview selection; good hook to substitute a livery item. Independent re-check (lab blind verifier 2026-11-27): partial, better name Game_Resolve_ItemFromEntryTable_OrDefault: Looks up param_3's 3-byte id in the same 0x30-byte entry table (+0x10, count +0x1810) and copies the entry if found, else builds a default from param_3; 'override' and 'customisation' semantics are not shown by the code.
